name: @sebastienelet/pr-consolidate
description: Repository-aware pull request consolidation with project-native checks and individual reviews.

scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run build && cargo test --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s skills/pr-consolidate/tests -p "test_*.py" -v
